def target_of(address):
    body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    return body, refs


def resolve(obj, rows):
    funcs = match.coff_functions(Path(obj).read_bytes())
    out = []
    for address, key in rows:
        hits = [x for x in funcs if x[0] == key] or [x for x in funcs if x[0].startswith(key) and not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(x[0])]
        if DISCOVER and len(hits) != 1:
            print('UNRESOLVED', '%08x' % address, key[:120], [h[0][:120] for h in hits])
            continue
        assert len(hits) == 1, ('%08x' % address, key, [h[0] for h in hits])
        out.append((address, hits[0][0]))
    return out


def bind_value(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, name, body, target, address, own):
    start, section = definitions[name]
    table = sections[section]
    code = raw[table[4] + start:]
    verified, local = {}, set()
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
            continue
        symbol = symbols[index][0]
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            local.add(symbol)
            continue
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
            how = '%s!%s' % hit
        elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
            assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
        elif symbol in ALIAS:
            assert ALIAS[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(ALIAS[symbol]))
            how = 'ICF-folded body (alias of a row proven here)'
        elif symbol in own:
            assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
            how = 'own row'
        elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
            how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else ' (call-site identification)')
        elif symbol in LOCAL_STATIC_AT:
            assert LOCAL_STATIC_AT[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(LOCAL_STATIC_AT[symbol]))
            how = 'static data (one address per symbol)'
        else:
            UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
            continue
        prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
        assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
        verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
    return verified, local


def verify(which, rows, own):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            entry['address'] = '%08x (not exact)' % address
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        verified, local = bind_value(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, name, body, target, address, own)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            # conservative: any entry marked exact anywhere in the receipt
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    a = o.get('address') or o.get('addr')
                    if a and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(a)
                    for v in o.values():
                        if isinstance(v, (list, dict)):
                            walk(v)
            walk(data)
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = (r.get('address') or r.get('addr') or '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

def resolve(obj, rows):

        if DISCOVER and len(hits) != 1:
            print('UNRESOLVED', '%08x' % address, key[:120], [h[0][:120] for h in hits])
            continue
        assert len(hits) == 1, ('%08x' % address, key, [h[0] for h in hits])
        out.append((address, hits[0][0]))
    return out


def bind_value(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, bodies, name, body, target, address, own, record=True):
    start, section = definitions[name]
    table = sections[section]
    code = raw[table[4] + start:]
    verified, local = {}, set()
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
            continue
        symbol = symbols[index][0]
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            local.add(symbol)
            continue
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
            how = '%s!%s' % hit
        elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
            assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
        elif symbol in own:
            assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
            how = 'own row'
        elif symbol in SUPPORT:
            assert SUPPORT[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(SUPPORT[symbol]))
            sbody, srefs = bodies[symbol]
            starget, strefs = target_of(value)
            assert match.exact_match(starget, strefs, sbody, srefs), ('support body not exact', symbol, hex(value))
            support_out[symbol] = '%08x' % value
            how = 'support body exact at the bound address'
        elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
            how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
        elif LOCAL_STATIC.match(symbol) and symbol in LOCAL_STATIC_AT:
            assert LOCAL_STATIC_AT[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(LOCAL_STATIC_AT[symbol]))
            how = 'local static'
        else:
            UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
            continue
        if record:
            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
            assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
        verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
    return verified, local


def verify(which, rows, own, strict=True, record=True):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict or DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        verified, local = bind_value(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, bodies, name, body, target, address, own, record)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

                elif isinstance(o, dict):

        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:

            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff

                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):

                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')

                if sections[at][4] == 0:

# ---- structure: allocation sizes before the constructor calls, RTTI bases --------------------------------------------
def new_then_ctor(at, size, ctor=None):
    """`push size; ... call operator new 006a0920` at `at`, optionally followed by the constructor call."""
    push = (b'\x6a' + bytes([size])) if size < 0x80 else (b'\x68' + struct.pack('<I', size))
    code = original.data(at, 0x40)
    assert code.startswith(push), (hex(at), code[:8].hex())
    calls = [at + i for i in range(len(code) - 5) if code[i] == 0xe8]
    targets = [(c, (c + 5 + struct.unpack('<i', original.data(c + 1, 4))[0]) & 0xffffffff) for c in calls]
    assert targets[0][1] == 0x6a0920, (hex(at), [hex(t) for _, t in targets])
    if ctor is not None:
        assert any(t == ctor for _, t in targets[1:]), (hex(at), hex(ctor))
    return '%08x: new(%#x)%s' % (at, size, (' before %08x' % ctor) if ctor else ' (constructor inlined)')

def compiled_vtable(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]

def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

ADDR = re.compile(r'^(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})$')


def counted_by_others():
    out = {}
    for path in sorted(glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json'))):
        if Path(path).resolve() == RECEIPT.resolve():
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        found = set()

        def add(x):
            m = ADDR.match(str(x.get('address', x.get('addr', '')) if isinstance(x, dict) else x).strip())
            if m:
                found.add(int(m.group(1), 16))
        for key in ('exact_function_rows', 'exact_addresses', 'exact_unique_addresses'):
            if isinstance(data.get(key), (list, dict)):
                for r in data[key]:
                    add(r)
        if 'exact_function_rows' not in data:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, dict):
                    if o.get('exact') is True and ('address' in o or 'addr' in o):
                        add(o)
                    for v in o.values():
                        walk(v)
                elif isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
            walk(data)
        for a in found:
            out.setdefault(a, []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

def classify(symbol, value, where):
    hit = original.imported(value)
    if hit is not None:
        assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
        return '%s!%s' % hit
    if symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
        pos, at = definitions[symbol]
        literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
        assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
    if symbol.startswith('__real@') and len(symbol) in (15, 23):
        bits = bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1]
        assert original.data(value, len(bits)) == bits, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
    if symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
        rtti = original.string(value + 8)
        assert rtti == '.' + symbol[5:-2], (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'RTTI %s' % rtti
    if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
        rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
        cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
        assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
    if symbol in own:
        assert own[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
        return 'own row'
    if symbol.startswith('??_E') and ('??_G' + symbol[4:]) in own:
        assert own['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'own row (??_E and ??_G folded)'
    if symbol in DATA_BYTES:
        at, data = DATA_BYTES[symbol]
        assert at == value and original.data(value, len(data)) == data, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'data %r' % data
    if symbol in DATA:
        assert DATA[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(DATA[symbol]))
        return 'static (constructed by its initializer; see data_statics)'
    if symbol in EXTERNAL:
        assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
        tag = ' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else ''
        if value in OTHERS:
            tag += ' (counted by %s)' % ', '.join(OTHERS[value])
        return 'external' + tag
    body_symbol = symbol
    if symbol.startswith('??_E') and symbol not in bodies and ('??_G' + symbol[4:]) in bodies:
        body_symbol = '??_G' + symbol[4:]     # the vector deleting destructor slot holds the ??_G body
    if body_symbol in bodies and not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(body_symbol):
        symbol = body_symbol
        body, refs = bodies[symbol]
        try:
            target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % value)
        except Exception:
            return None
        if match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs):
            if symbol not in support:
                support[symbol] = value
                pending.append((value, symbol))
            assert support[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'support body exact at the bound address'
            if value in OTHERS:
                how += ' (counted by %s)' % ', '.join(OTHERS[value])
            return how
        return None
    if symbol.startswith('??_E') and ('??_G' + symbol[4:]) in support:
        assert support['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'support body (??_E and ??_G folded)'
    if LOCAL_STATIC.match(symbol) or symbol.startswith(('?flag@', '?foo@', '?root@', '?n@?1???$doDeclare@', '?type@?1???$singleton@')):
        return 'local static'
    return None


def verify(address, name):
    body, refs = bodies[name]
    target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    if not match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs):
        return None
    start, section = definitions[name]
    table = sections[section]
    code = raw[table[4] + start:]
    verified, local = {}, set()
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
            continue
        symbol = symbols[index][0]
        assert kind in (6, 20), (name, symbol, kind)
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            local.add(symbol)
            continue
        how = classify(symbol, value, name)
        if how is None:
            UNBOUND.append('    %r: %#x,   # in %s' % (symbol, value, name[:100]))
            continue
        prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
        if prev[0] != value:
            UNBOUND.append('inconsistent %s: %s (%s) vs %s (%s)' % (symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name))
        verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
    return {'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)}

def try_fold(which, symbol, value):
    """A compiler helper / COMDAT body bound outside the counted rows: the body compiled here must be exact there."""
    if symbol not in BODIES[which] or value not in FUNCTIONS:
        return False
    body, refs = BODIES[which][symbol]
    target, target_refs = target_of(value)
    if not match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs):

    FOLDED.setdefault(symbol, (value, which))

    return False

def verify(which, rows, own, strict=True, record=True):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = BODIES[which]
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict or DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol in OWN_DATA_SYMBOLS and symbol in definitions:
                # data defined in this unit (char sPartDragTool[] / sGroupDragTool[]): compare the bytes
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                if sections[at][4] == 0:
                    UNBOUND.append('    %r: %#x,   # own data without raw bytes in %s' % (symbol, value, name[:60]))
                    continue
                data = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + pos + OWN_DATA_SYMBOLS[symbol]]
                assert original.data(value, len(data)) == data, (name, symbol, hex(value), data)
                prev = OWN_DATA.setdefault(symbol, value)
                assert prev == value, (symbol, hex(prev), hex(value))
                how = 'own data %r' % data.rstrip(b'\0').decode('latin-1')
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
                USED_EXTERNAL.add(symbol)
            elif local_static(symbol, value):
                how = 'local static'
            elif try_fold(which, symbol, value):
                how = 'helper / COMDAT body, compared exact at the bound address'
            else:
                UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
                continue
            if record:
                prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
                assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

# ---- structure: allocation sizes before the constructor calls, RTTI bases --------------------------------------------
def new_before(call_site, ctor, size):
    window = original.data(call_site - 0x60, 0x65)
    assert window[-5] == 0xe8 and call_site + 5 + struct.unpack_from('<i', window, 0x61)[0] == ctor, hex(call_site)
    push = (b'\x6a' + bytes([size])) if size < 0x80 else (b'\x68' + struct.pack('<I', size))
    # the last `push size` before the constructor call, then the first `call operator new` after it (the operand
    # loads in between are scheduled by the compiler: PartDragTool() 00665f8f pushes 0x70 before the hitWorld copy)
    at = window.rindex(push)
    calls = [i for i in range(at + len(push), len(window) - 9)
             if window[i] == 0xe8 and call_site - 0x60 + i + 5 + struct.unpack_from('<i', window, i + 1)[0] == 0x6a0920]
    assert calls, hex(call_site)
    return '%08x: new(%#x) before %08x' % (call_site, size, ctor)

def compiled_vtable(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]


def check_vtable(obj, symbol, address, base):
    out, bad = [], []
    for i, slot in enumerate(compiled_vtable(obj, symbol)):
        value = d(address + 4 * i)
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if slot.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + slot[4:] in slot_names:
            ok, how = slot_names['??_G' + slot[4:]] == value, 'bound (??_G row)'
        elif slot in slot_names:
            ok, how = slot_names[slot] == value, 'bound' + (' (pending-build-only row)' if slot in pending_slot else '')
        elif hit is not None:
            ok, how = hit[1] == nb.plain(slot), 'import thunk %s!%s' % hit
        elif names.get(value, '') == slot:
            ok, how = True, 'evidence name at the slot target'
        elif ('@MouseCommand@RBX@@' in slot or '@IRenderable@RBX@@' in slot) and not slot.startswith('??_'):
            ok, how = d(BASE_VTABLES[base][0] + 4 * i) == value, 'inherited: same slot of the MouseCommand %s vtable' % base
        else:
            ok, how = False, 'unbound'
        out.append({'slot': i, 'symbol': slot, 'original': '%08x' % value, 'ok': ok, 'how': how})
        if not ok:
            bad.append((i, slot, hex(value), how, names.get(value, '')[:80]))
    assert not bad or DISCOVER, (symbol, bad)
    if bad:
        print('VTABLE', symbol[:60], bad)
    return out

# ---- counting rules ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}

            assert not strict or DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')
            elif symbol.startswith('__TI'):
                cls = '.?AV' + symbol[symbol.index('?AV') + 3:]
                assert throw_info_type(value) == cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), throw_info_type(value))
                THROW_INFO[symbol] = (value, cls)
                how = 'throw info %s' % cls
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0?AV'):
                cls = symbol[5:symbol.rindex('@8')]
                assert original.string(value + 8) == '.' + cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), original.string(value + 8))
                how = 'type descriptor %s' % original.string(value + 8)
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol in own:

                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + symbol[4:] in own:

                assert own['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))

                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
            elif local_static(symbol, value):

            else:

            if record:

                assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def new_before(call_site, ctor, size):
    window = original.data(call_site - 0x60, 0x65)
    assert window[-5] == 0xe8 and call_site + 5 + struct.unpack_from('<i', window, 0x61)[0] == ctor, hex(call_site)
    push = (b'\x6a' + bytes([size])) if size < 0x80 else (b'\x68' + struct.pack('<I', size))
    at = window.rindex(push + b'\xe8')
    assert call_site - 0x60 + at + len(push) + 5 + struct.unpack_from('<i', window, at + len(push) + 1)[0] == 0x6a0920, \
        hex(call_site)

def compiled_vtable(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]


def check_vtable(obj, symbol, address):
    out, bad = [], []
    for i, slot in enumerate(compiled_vtable(obj, symbol)):
        value = d(address + 4 * i)
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if slot.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + slot[4:] in slot_names:
            ok, how = slot_names['??_G' + slot[4:]] == value, 'bound (??_G)'
        elif slot in slot_names:
            ok, how = slot_names[slot] == value, 'bound'
        elif hit is not None:
            ok, how = hit[1] == nb.plain(slot), 'import thunk %s!%s' % hit
        else:
            ok, how = False, 'unbound'
        out.append({'slot': i, 'symbol': slot, 'original': '%08x' % value, 'ok': ok, 'how': how})
        if not ok:
            bad.append((i, slot, hex(value), how))
    assert not bad, (symbol, bad)
    return out

def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

def resolve(obj, rows):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    funcs = match.coff_functions(raw)
    out = []
    for address, key in rows:
        hits = [x for x in funcs if x[0] == key] or [x for x in funcs if x[0].startswith(key)
                                                       and not LOCAL_EH.match(x[0])]
        assert len(hits) == 1, (address, key, [h[0] for h in hits])
        out.append((int(address, 16), hits[0][0]))
    return out


def data_key(symbol):
    if symbol in DATA:
        return symbol
    hits = [k for k in DATA if symbol.startswith(k)]
    return hits[0] if len(hits) == 1 else None


def verify(obj, rows, own):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        assert match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs), (name, hex(address), len(body), len(target))
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
                rtti = original.string(value + 8)
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol.startswith('??_E') and own.get('??_G' + symbol[4:]) == value:
                how = 'vector deleting dtor folded into the ??_G row'
            elif symbol.startswith('__TI') and '?AV' in symbol:
                # _ThrowInfo: pCatchableTypeArray +12 -> first CatchableType -> TypeDescriptor name
                cta = struct.unpack('<I', original.data(value + 12, 4))[0]
                ct = struct.unpack('<I', original.data(cta + 4, 4))[0]
                rtti = original.string(struct.unpack('<I', original.data(ct + 4, 4))[0] + 8)
                assert rtti == '.' + symbol[symbol.index('?AV'):], (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'throw info %s' % rtti
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                literal = bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1]
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'float constant'
            elif data_key(symbol):
                assert DATA[data_key(symbol)] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                if value in NAMES:
                    assert original.string(value) == NAMES[value], (symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'data'
            elif EXTERNAL.get(symbol) is not None:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
            elif symbol.startswith('?$S') or symbol.startswith('??_B?1') or '?$TSS' in symbol or symbol.startswith('?flag@') \
                    or symbol.startswith('?foo@') or symbol.startswith('?n@?1??') or symbol.startswith('?v@?1??') or symbol.startswith('?type@?1??'):
                how = 'local static'
            else:
                unbound.setdefault(symbol, set()).add((hex(value), name[:60]))
                continue
            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
            assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        result.append({'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'exact': True,
                       'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
    return result

def bases(vtable):
    hierarchy = d(d(vtable - 4) + 16)
    out = {}
    for i in range(d(hierarchy + 8)):
        bcd = d(d(hierarchy + 12) + 4 * i)
        out[original.string(d(bcd) + 8)] = struct.unpack('<i', original.data(bcd + 8, 4))[0]
    return out

def vtable_slots(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, index = definitions[symbol]
    section = sections[index]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(section[7]):
        offset, sym, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, section[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start and kind == 6:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[sym][0]
    return slots


def find_vtable(obj, prefix):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    _, _, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    hits = [n for n in definitions if n.startswith(prefix)]
    assert len(hits) == 1, (prefix, hits)
    return hits[0]

                how = 'float constant'

def vtable_slots(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, index = definitions[symbol]
    section = sections[index]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(section[7]):
        offset, sym, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, section[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start and kind == 6:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[sym][0]
    return slots


def find_vtable(obj, prefix):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    _, _, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    hits = [n for n in definitions if n.startswith(prefix)]
    assert len(hits) == 1, (prefix, hits)
    return hits[0]

def target_of(address):

def resolve(obj, rows):
    funcs = match.coff_functions(Path(obj).read_bytes())
    out = []
    for address, key in rows:
        hits = [x for x in funcs if x[0] == key] or [x for x in funcs if x[0].startswith(key) and not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(x[0])]

        assert len(hits) == 1, ('%08x' % address, key, [h[0] for h in hits])

def bind_value(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, name, body, target, address, own, extra=None, record=True, limit=None):
    """Verify every relocation of `name` (body compared against target); returns {symbol: proof}, local EH set."""
    start, section = definitions[name]
    table = sections[section]
    code = raw[table[4] + start:]
    verified, local = {}, set()
    size = len(body) if limit is None else limit
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < size:
            continue
        symbol = symbols[index][0]
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            local.add(symbol)
            continue
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
            how = '%s!%s' % hit
        elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
            pos, at = definitions[symbol]
            literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
            assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
        elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
            rtti = original.string(value + 8)
            assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
        elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
            assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
        elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
            rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
            cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
            assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            VTABLES.setdefault(symbol, value)
            how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
        elif symbol.startswith('??_8'):
            pos, at = definitions[symbol]
            blob = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + pos + 8]
            assert original.data(value, 8) == blob, (name, symbol, hex(value), blob.hex())
            how = 'vbtable bytes %s' % blob.hex()
        elif symbol in own:
            assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
            how = 'own row'
        elif symbol in FOLDED:
            assert FOLDED[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'folded'
        elif symbol in DATA:
            assert DATA[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'data'
        elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
            how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
        elif symbol in UNPROVEN:
            assert UNPROVEN[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'call target of a built, non-counted row'
        elif symbol.startswith('__TI'):
            # ThrowInfo -> CatchableTypeArray (+0xc) -> first CatchableType (+4) -> TypeDescriptor (+4) -> name
            d = lambda a: struct.unpack('<I', original.data(a, 4))[0]
            rtti = original.string(d(d(d(value + 12) + 4) + 4) + 8)
            assert rtti == '.' + symbol[symbol.index('?'):], (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            how = 'throw info, first catchable type %s' % rtti
        elif extra is not None and symbol in extra:
            assert extra[symbol] in (None, value), (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'pending-build external'
        elif symbol.startswith('??_B?1??') or symbol.startswith('?$S') or '?$TSS' in symbol or symbol.startswith('?s@?1??'):
            how = 'local static'
        else:
            UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
            continue
        if record:
            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
            assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
        verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
    return verified, local

def verify(which, rows, own, strict=True, record=True, extra=None, limit=None):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        if limit:
            exact = len(body) == limit and match.exact_match(target[:limit], [r for r in target_refs if r < limit], body, refs)
        else:
            exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict or DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        verified, local = bind_value(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, name, body, target, address, own, extra, record, limit)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local),
                      'vtables': sorted(x for x in verified if x.startswith('??_7'))})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def vtable_slots(which, symbol):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]

def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

               'bool IsEmpty() const throw()\n\t{\n\t\treturn( GetLength() == 0 );'):

unit = OUT / 'NativeBrowserViewProfile.cpp'
unit.write_text(body)
obj = OUT / 'NativeBrowserViewProfile.obj'
code, log = rebuild.run(tool, 'cl', ['/nologo', '/c', '/O2', '/Ob2', '/Oy', '/GF', '/GS-', '/EHsc', '/MD', '/Fo' + str(obj), str(unit)], OUT)
assert code == 0, log[-3000:]

for rel in ('CommandBars/XTPToolBar.cpp', 'CommandBars/XTPControlComboBox.cpp', 'CommandBars/XTPControl.cpp',

# The static paint manager pointer: SetTheme 006af0a0 (XTP) writes it; check the data address the XTP body uses.

    '??0CSecureHtmlView@@QAE@XZ': 0x465a60,

S = 'V?$basic_string@DU?$char_traits@D@std@@V?$allocator@D@2@@'
N = 'U_Node@?$_List_nod@V?$basic_string@DU?$char_traits@D@std@@V?$allocator@D@2@@std@@V?$allocator@V?$basic_string@DU?$char_traits@D@std@@V?$allocator@D@2@@std@@@2@@2@'
IT = 'V?$_Iterator@$00@?$' + L
IT0 = 'V?$_Iterator@$0A@@?$' + L
METHODS = [
    ('?CreateObject@CBrowserView@@SGPAVCObject@@XZ', 0x410d60),
    ('?CreateObject@CIDEBrowserView@@SGPAVCObject@@XZ', 0x410dc0),
    ('?CreateObject@CPlayBrowserView@@SGPAVCObject@@XZ', 0x410e20),
    ('??_GCBrowserView@@UAEPAXI@Z', 0x410e80),
    ('?GetRuntimeClass@CBrowserView@@UBEPAUCRuntimeClass@@XZ', 0x40df60),
    ('?GetRuntimeClass@CIDEBrowserView@@UBEPAUCRuntimeClass@@XZ', 0x40df70),
    ('?GetRuntimeClass@CPlayBrowserView@@UBEPAUCRuntimeClass@@XZ', 0x40df80),
    ('?GetMessageMap@CBrowserView@@MBEPBUAFX_MSGMAP@@XZ', 0x40f810),
    ('??0CBrowserView@@QAE@XZ', 0x4108b0),
    ('??1CBrowserView@@UAE@XZ', 0x410950),
    ('??0CIDEBrowserView@@QAE@XZ', 0x410c40),
    ('??0CPlayBrowserView@@QAE@XZ', 0x410cd0),
    ('??1?$CXTPCommandBarsSiteBase@VCSecureHtmlView@@@@UAE@XZ', 0x40e230),
    ('?PreTranslateMessage@?$CXTPCommandBarsSiteBase@VCSecureHtmlView@@@@MAEHPAUtagMSG@@@Z', 0x40e290),
    ('?OnWndMsg@?$CXTPCommandBarsSiteBase@VCSecureHtmlView@@@@MAEHIIJPAJ@Z', 0x40e320),
    ('?OnInitialUpdate@CBrowserView@@UAEXXZ', 0x40ed50),
    ('?OnGetHostInfo@CBrowserView@@UAEJPAU_DOCHOSTUIINFO@@@Z', 0x40dfb0),
    ('?OnCommandStateChange@CBrowserView@@UAEXJH@Z', 0x40dfe0),
    ('?OnDocumentComplete@CBrowserView@@UAEXPBD@Z', 0x40dfd0),
    ('?OnTitleChange@CBrowserView@@UAEXPBD@Z', 0x40e560),
    ('?OnNavigateComplete2@CBrowserView@@UAEXPBD@Z', 0x410ea0),
    ('?OnBeforeNavigate2@CBrowserView@@UAEXPBDK0AAVCByteArray@@0PAH@Z', 0x4109e0),
    ('?OnEraseBkgnd@CBrowserView@@QAEHPAVCDC@@@Z', 0x6e8870),
    ('?OnSize@CBrowserView@@QAEXIHH@Z', 0x40e040),
    ('?OnCreate@CBrowserView@@QAEHPAUtagCREATESTRUCTA@@@Z', 0x40e5b0),
    ('?OnStop@CBrowserView@@QAEXXZ', 0x40e930),
    ('?OnUpdateStop@CBrowserView@@QAEXPAVCCmdUI@@@Z', 0x40e940),
    ('?OnHome@CBrowserView@@QAEXXZ', 0x40e790),

    ('?OnForward@CBrowserView@@QAEXXZ', 0x40e7e0),
    ('?OnUpdateForward@CBrowserView@@QAEXPAVCCmdUI@@@Z', 0x40e0f0),

    ('?OnUpdateGo@CBrowserView@@QAEXPAVCCmdUI@@@Z', 0x40e110),
    ('?OnAddressExecute@CBrowserView@@QAEXPAUtagNMHDR@@PAJ@Z', 0x40eda0),
    ('?OnCreateControl@CBrowserView@@QAEHPAUXTP_COMMANDBARS_CREATECONTROL@@@Z', 0x40e670),
    # std::list<std::string> instances emitted by this unit (identical COMDATs in the original)
    ('??0?$' + L + 'QAE@XZ', 0x410830),
    ('??1?$' + L + 'QAE@XZ', 0x55e5f0),
    ('?clear@?$' + L + 'QAEXXZ', 0x55dfd0),
    ('?_Buynode@?$' + L + 'IAEPA' + N + 'XZ', 0x40f1c0),
    ('?_Incsize@?$' + L + 'IAEXI@Z', 0x40edd0),
    ('?erase@?$' + L + 'QAE?AV?$_Iterator@$00@12@V?$_Const_iterator@$00@12@@Z', 0x410350),
    ('??$find@' + IT, 0x410bd0),      # prefix, resolved below
    ('??$_Find@' + IT0, 0x40f7c0),    # prefix, resolved below

present = {n for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(obj.read_bytes())}
METHODS = [(n if n in present else next(p for p in sorted(present) if p.startswith(n)), a) for n, a in METHODS]
missing = [n for n, a in METHODS if n not in present]
assert not missing, missing
# CXTPControlComboBox::DeleteItem (XTP AFX_INLINE, emitted out of line by this unit): the analysed extent of 0040e470
# is 81 bytes but includes the next function 0040e4b0; the 64-byte body (ret 4 at 0040e4ad) is exact as a prefix.
DELETE_ITEM = '?DeleteItem@CXTPControlComboBox@@QAEXJ@Z'
db, dr = next((b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(obj.read_bytes()) if n == DELETE_ITEM)
dt, dtr, _ = match.target('2008-06', '0040e470')
assert len(db) == 64 and dt[63:64] == b'\x00' and dt[61] == 0xc2 and match.exact_match(dt[:64], [x for x in dtr if x < 64], db, dr)
INTERNAL[DELETE_ITEM] = 0x40e470
# list::_Buynode(next, prev, value): the COFF body carries its catch(...) funclet (rethrow after freeing the node);
# the original's analysed extent 0040f1e0 (124 bytes, ret 0Ch) ends before it. Main body exact as a prefix.
BUYNODE = '?_Buynode@?$' + L + 'IAEPA' + N + 'PAU342@0AB' + S + '2@@Z'
bb, br = next((b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(obj.read_bytes()) if n == BUYNODE)
bt, btr, _ = match.target('2008-06', '0040f1e0')
assert len(bt) == 124 and bt[-3:] == b'\xc2\x0c\x00' and match.exact_match(bt, btr, bb[:124], [x for x in br if x < 124])
INTERNAL[BUYNODE] = 0x40f1e0
# _Incsize throws std::length_error: check the ThrowInfo's catchable types by RTTI name.
_, _, _, cta = struct.unpack('<4I', original.data(0x8d0cc0, 16))
count = struct.unpack('<I', original.data(cta, 4))[0]
names = [original.string(struct.unpack('<I', original.data(struct.unpack('<I', original.data(cta + 4 + 4 * i, 4))[0] + 4, 4))[0] + 8)
         for i in range(count)]
assert names == ['.?AVlength_error@std@@', '.?AVlogic_error@std@@', '.?AVexception@std@@'], names
INTERNAL['__TI3?AVlength_error@std@@'] = 0x8d0cc0
rows = verify(original, obj, METHODS, INTERNAL)
# Folded bodies: the subclass deleting destructors are the same bytes at 00410e80.
for extra in ('??_GCIDEBrowserView@@UAEPAXI@Z', '??_GCPlayBrowserView@@UAEPAXI@Z'):
    rows += verify(original, obj, [(extra, 0x410e80)], INTERNAL, dict(METHODS))

# CRuntimeClass records: name, size, schema, CreateObject, base getter (jmp to CSecureHtmlView/CBrowserView GetRuntimeClass)
def runtime(address, name, create, base_getter):
    rec = struct.unpack('<IiIIII', original.data(address, 24))
    assert original.string(rec[0]) == name and rec[1:5] == (0x2d0, 0xffff, create, base_getter), (name, rec)
runtime(0x80cf58, 'CBrowserView', 0x410d60, 0x436060)      # 00436060: jmp 00465a50 (CSecureHtmlView::GetRuntimeClass)
runtime(0x80cf74, 'CIDEBrowserView', 0x410dc0, 0x40df60)
runtime(0x80cf90, 'CPlayBrowserView', 0x410e20, 0x40df60)
assert original.data(0x436060, 1) == b'\xe9' and 0x436065 + struct.unpack('<i', original.data(0x436061, 4))[0] == 0x465a50

# Message map 0080d414 (base CHtmlView::GetThisMessageMap import)
base_getter, entries = struct.unpack('<II', original.data(0x80d414, 8))
assert original.imported(base_getter)[1] == '?GetThisMessageMap@CHtmlView@@KGPBUAFX_MSGMAP@@XZ'
handlers = [struct.unpack('<6I', original.data(entries + 24 * i, 24)) for i in range(18)]
expected = [(0x14, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0x6e8870), (0x5, 0, 0, 0, 0x19, 0x40e040), (0x1, 0, 0, 0, 0xd, 0x40e5b0),
            (0x111, 0, 0x80bb, 0x80bb, 0x39, 0x40e930), (0x111, 0xffffffff, 0x80bb, 0x80bb, 0x41, 0x40e940),
            (0x111, 0, 0x80bd, 0x80bd, 0x39, 0x40e790), (0x111, 0xffffffff, 0x80bd, 0x80bd, 0x41, 0x40e130),
            (0x111, 0, 0x80bc, 0x80bc, 0x39, 0x40e7d0), (0x111, 0xffffffff, 0x80bc, 0x80bc, 0x41, 0x42e550),
            (0x111, 0, 0x80ba, 0x80ba, 0x39, 0x40e920), (0x111, 0xffffffff, 0x80ba, 0x80ba, 0x41, 0x40e0d0),
            (0x111, 0, 0x80b9, 0x80b9, 0x39, 0x40e7e0), (0x111, 0xffffffff, 0x80b9, 0x80b9, 0x41, 0x40e0f0),
            (0x111, 0, 0x80ca, 0x80ca, 0x39, 0x40e7f0), (0x111, 0xffffffff, 0x80ca, 0x80ca, 0x41, 0x40e110),
            (0x4e, 0x64, 0x80c9, 0x80c9, 0x3d, 0x40eda0), (0x285e, 0, 0, 0, 0xd, 0x40e670), (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)]
assert handlers == expected, handlers

open_items = {
    '0040fff0': 'OnGetExternal: 2-instruction scheduling difference (object pointer reloaded after the isIDE store; '
                'original converts to IBrowserViewExternal before the store without a null check)',

}
(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/browser-view-working.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'class': 'CBrowserView', 'subclasses': ['CIDEBrowserView', 'CPlayBrowserView'],
    'compiler': 'MSVC 15.00.21022 (VS2008 RTM)', 'flags': FLAGS + XTP_FLAGS,

    'original_sha256': sha(original.path), 'object_sha256': sha(obj),
    'sources': {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\', '/'): sha(p) for p in (Path(__file__), source, HEADERS / 'CBrowserView.h', HEADERS / 'CBrowserDoc.h',
                                         HEADERS / 'CBrowserViewExternal.h', HEADERS / 'CBrowserFrameWnd.h', HERE / 'NativeBrowserViewLayout.cpp')},
    'xtp_targets': {'%08x' % XTP_TARGETS[s]: '%s: %s' % (s, xtp_proof[s]) for s in XTP_TARGETS},
    'methods': rows, 'open': open_items}, indent=2) + '\n')
weak = [s for s, p in xtp_proof.items() if p != 'XTP recipe body exact']
print('PASS native CBrowserView: %d exact bodies, targets verified; XTP targets body-proven %d/%d%s'
      % (len(rows), len(XTP_TARGETS) - len(weak), len(XTP_TARGETS), (' (call-site only: %s)' % ', '.join(weak)) if weak else ''))

def classify(symbol, value, own, raw, sections, definitions, where):
    """Return how a relocation target bound to `value` is verified, or None when unknown."""
    hit = original.imported(value)
    if hit is not None:
        assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
        return '%s!%s' % hit

        pos, at = definitions[symbol]
        literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
        assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
    if symbol.startswith('__real@') and len(symbol) == 15:
        bits = struct.pack('<I', int(symbol[7:], 16))
        assert original.data(value, 4) == bits, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'float constant %r' % struct.unpack('<f', bits)
    if symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
        rtti = original.string(value + 8)
        assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'RTTI %s' % rtti
    if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
        rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
        cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
        assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
    if symbol in own:
        assert own[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
        return 'own row'
    if symbol.startswith('??_E') and ('??_G' + symbol[4:]) in own:
        assert own['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'own row (??_G)'
    if symbol in FOLDED:
        assert FOLDED[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'folded'
    at = data_address(symbol)
    if at is not None:
        assert at == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(at))
        return 'data'
    if symbol in EXTERNAL:
        assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
        return 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
    if symbol.startswith('??_B?1??') or symbol.startswith('?$S') or '?$TSS' in symbol or symbol.startswith('?flag@') \
            or symbol.startswith('?foo@') or symbol.startswith('?root@') or symbol.startswith('?n@?1???$doDeclare@'):

    return None

    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        assert match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs), (name, hex(address), len(body), len(target))
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            how = classify(symbol, value, own, raw, sections, definitions, name)
            if how is None:

            assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        result.append({'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'exact': True,
                       'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
    return result

def resolve(obj, rows):

def data_address(symbol):

def classify(symbol, value, own, raw, sections, definitions, where):
    """Return how a relocation target bound to `value` is verified, or None when unknown."""
    hit = original.imported(value)
    if hit is not None:
        assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
        return '%s!%s' % hit
    if symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
        pos, at = definitions[symbol]
        literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
        assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
    if symbol.startswith('__real@') and len(symbol) == 15:
        bits = struct.pack('<I', int(symbol[7:], 16))
        assert original.data(value, 4) == bits, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'float constant %r' % struct.unpack('<f', bits)
    if symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
        rtti = original.string(value + 8)
        assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'RTTI %s' % rtti
    if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
        rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
        cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
        assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
    if symbol in own:
        assert own[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
        return 'own row'
    if symbol.startswith('??_E') and ('??_G' + symbol[4:]) in own:
        assert own['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'own row (??_G)'
    if symbol in FOLDED:
        assert FOLDED[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'folded'
    at = data_address(symbol)
    if at is not None:
        assert at == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(at))
        return 'data'
    if symbol in EXTERNAL:
        assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
        return 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
    if symbol.startswith('??_B?1??') or symbol.startswith('?$S') or '?$TSS' in symbol or symbol.startswith('?flag@') \
            or symbol.startswith('?foo@') or symbol.startswith('?root@') or symbol.startswith('?n@?1???$doDeclare@'):
        return 'local static'
    return None


def verify(obj, rows, own):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        assert match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs), (name, hex(address), len(body), len(target))
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            how = classify(symbol, value, own, raw, sections, definitions, name)
            if how is None:
                UNBOUND.append('%s in %s -> %s' % (symbol, name, hex(value)))
                continue
            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
            assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        result.append({'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'exact': True,
                       'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
    return result
